newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKEY SELLS 259.9 TRLN LIRA OF 357-DAY BILLS.
newsitem.headline: TURKEY SELLS 259.9 TRLN LIRA OF 357-DAY BILLS.

text.p: The Turkish Treasury met half of the bids in its 357-day bill auction on Tuesday by selling 259.9 trillion lira of nominal-valued bills at slightly higher yield.
It had last sold 351.6 trillion lira of 357-day bills at 137.22 percent yield (including witholding tax) on August 5.
The maximum yield excluding witholding tax equals to 119.99 percent.
Banks will pay 108.3 trillion lira to the Treasury for the auction on Wednesday when the central bank will repay 61 trillion lira to banks for maturing reverse repos on the open market.
